description: Summarises the feedback posted about an agent in the ERC-8004 reputation registry on Base, at one block: number of distinct clients, number of feedback entries, the registry's own summary value, and each client's latest entry (value, tags, revoked). It is EVIDENCE, not a verdict: anyone can post feedback from any address, so many clients is not proof of many people, and tag text is free text written by the client (shown as untrusted).
name: erc8004_reputation
title: ERC-8004 reputation evidence
